name: unsafe fn async_drop_in_place < T : ? Sized > (to_drop : * mut T) -> AsyncDropInPlace < T >
rule: While `async_drop_in_place` is executing or the returned async destructor is alive, parts of `to_drop` may be accessed only through the `self: Pin<&mut Self>` references supplied to the `AsyncDrop::async_drop` methods invoked by `async_drop_in_place` or `AsyncDropInPlace<T>::poll`.
api: unsafe fn async_drop_in_place < T : ? Sized > (to_drop : * mut T) -> core::future::async_drop::AsyncDropInPlace < T >
expression: The supplied DSL cannot express this requirement: it has no observations for temporal access events or the identities of references through which access occurs.
